name: Neko ni Nareta nara
source:
Amaya Haruno is a girl with no money, no house, and no job.

One day, she came across a stray cat being picked up on the side of the road where she was walking aimlessly.

"I want to be a cat," she said out loud.

"Then, why don't you become my cat?" said a strange man passing by.

Haruno, a poor woman who wants to be a cat, and Akahoshi, a strange man, began to live together strangely.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18984]Freem![/url]]
translation:
天谷遥乃是一个没钱、没房、没工作的女孩。

某天，漫无目的地在街上游荡时，她看见路边一只流浪猫被人收养。

“我也想变成猫。”她不由得说出了口。

“那，要不要来当我的猫？”路过的一个陌生男人回应道。

想变成猫的落魄女子遥乃，与古怪的男人赤星，就这样开始了奇妙的同居生活。
